text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx error-rate spike for /api/v1/generate — 5xx rate 12.3% (threshold 3%). Rolling 5m request rate up 150%. Incident key: PD-INC-12458. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-12458

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-12458 is unacknowledged. Paging on-call (primary). If no ack within 5m will escalate to secondary.

Alex Chan: ack — I'm on it. hopping into logs now.

eng-sre-bot: Snapshot of service metrics attached: request_rate: 9.8k RPS, 5xx_rate: 12.3%, p95 latency: 240ms, memory pressure: 72%. Noting error class: upstream 502/503 from runtime-exec.

Alex Chan: quick check: recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed 18m ago: release/2026-03-14-serve-2.3.1 -> rolled to 20% canary then 100% at 12:34 UTC. No automated rollbacks.

Sophie R.: customer-impact: monitoring shows elevated errors for a small set of high-volume customers using long-context generation (seq_len > 8k). Estimated impacted requests ~18% of total traffic but ~40% of revenue-weighted calls.

Alex Chan: running quick curl against a failing request to reproduce:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/generate 
-H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 
-d '{"model":"xlarge-quant","input":"<...long prompt...>","max_tokens":2048}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
body: "upstream read error: kv-cache OOM"

Mira Patel: thanks Alex. tagging in @Mira Patel (scheduling) as backup — Mira are you able to join?

Mira Patel: on it, joining. I see repeated stack: `runtime.exec: alloc failed: requested 1.6GB, available 0.6GB` from inference-worker-7. Looks like cache growth during long contexts.

Alex Chan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert to previous runtime build (pre-2.3.1) on a small subset, 2) add autoscale temp to inference pool, 3) enable model-variant fallback to smaller-quant model for long-context requests. I'll start 2 and 3 now if Mira confirms.

Mira Patel: agree. Alex kick off autoscale (scale up by 3 GPUs in eu-west-1) and enable fallback policy. I'll prepare rollback if infra doesn't stabilize in 6m.

Alex Chan: scaling up:
```
# k8s scale command (running)
kubectl -n redwood-scale patch hpa inference-pool --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":8}]'
```
Scale job submitted — pods pending.

eng-sre-bot: Autoscaling event: requested +3 pods, 2 pods scheduled, 1 pending due to quota; provisioning new GPU instances (estimated 90s).

Alex Chan: enabling fallback route rule to quant-compact for requests with seq_len > 6k:
```
route.add(rule="long-context-fallback", filter="seq_len>6000", target="xlarge-quant-compact", priority=10)
```
Deployed rule to routing tier.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-12458 acknowledged by Alex Chan at 2026-03-14 12:40:21 UTC.

Sophie R.: updated customer-facing status: "We're investigating increased errors affecting long-context workloads for a subset of customers. Engineers are mitigating and we will provide updates every 15 minutes." Sending to affected customers list now.

Mira Patel: partial recovery visible: 5xx rate dropping to 6.8% after fallback rule + autoscale. p95 latency increased slightly to 270ms.

Alex Chan: still seeing some 502s from worker-7 logs: `kv-cache: leaked references -> mem-tracking spike` — will restart that pod.

eng-sre-bot: Pod restart initiated: inference-worker-7 -> recreated on node n-gpu-42. New pod ready in 47s.

Alex Chan: after restart, errors down to 2.1% across the board. Routing fallbacks handled majority of long-context requests.

Mira Patel: pulling deploy logs and comparing recent changes: GC threshold change in runtime commit b7c9f1 altered kv-cache eviction heuristics. That lines up with timing.

Alex Chan: mitigation status: autoscale + fallback + pod restart = stable baseline. Next steps: roll back runtime change or patch eviction logic. I'm opening a rollback PR to deploy pre-2.3.1 build to canary 10% to validate.

Sophie R.: Customer comms updated: notified top-10 impacted customers, offered priority support and temporary quota bump. All outbound emails queued.

Mira Patel: consequences and severity: classifying as P1 for now due to revenue impact. Will start postmortem doc once incident is closed. Adding timeline notes.

Alex Chan: handoff: my shift ends in 40m — Mira will take lead for next steps and postmortem. If anything regresses pls page Mira directly.

Mira Patel: confirmed. I'll own the rollback decision and postmortem. Thanks Alex — great quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation suspended (acknowledged) — no further pages for 15m.

incident-bot: Scheduled check-in reminders: next status update due 12:55 UTC.

Alex Chan: quick note for postmortem: include metrics: pre-spike 5xx 0.9%, spike 12.3% at 12:36 UTC, mitigated to 2.1% by 12:48 UTC. Attach logs: /var/log/ingest/2026-03-14/inference-worker-7.log.gz

Mira Patel: logging action items: 1) revert kv-cache config in runtime (owner: infra-runtime), 2) add guardrail to prevent kv-cache expansion beyond node memory (owner: eng-ml), 3) add targeted unit/regression test for long-context eviction (owner: research), 4) update runbook to prefer fallback rule earlier (owner: eng-sre).

Sophie R.: Will prepare customer follow-up template and credits as needed.

Alex Chan: closing notes: no data exfiltration or auth issues observed. All services green in eu-west-1 now. Will add final notes after postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-12458: status set to "stabilized" by Alex Chan at 12:49:01 UTC. Next: postmortem.

Mira Patel: taking over the incident channel for postmortem drafting. If anything else pops up, ping me.
